# Mushroom Cultivation

Curated by Skill Harbor — a hands-on home cultivation guide for edible and medicinal mushrooms: choosing beginner-friendly species (oyster, shiitake, lion's mane, wine cap), preparing substrate (straw pasteurization, sawdust sterilization, cold lime bath), inoculation technique, incubation conditions, fruiting triggers, harvest timing, and managing successive flushes — with contamination troubleshooting at every step.
